name: The Fisherman’s Son (Young King)
description: A fisherman’s child raised by the king, brave enough to endure trolls’ torment to free the princesses, yet fated to lose and reclaim his queen through hard-won wisdom.
visualPrompt: Young fairytale king in his late teens or early twenties with wind-chapped, travel-worn face and earnest eyes, wearing rich but rugged northern clothes and a dark cloak; a small ring is tied into his hair, and he carries a simple sword, standing with steady determination.

name: The Youngest Princess of Whiteland (The Queen)
description: The cleverest of the three sisters, she guides the hero through the trolls’ trial, becomes his queen, and sets the crucial condition he tragically breaks.
visualPrompt: Young princess with calm, intelligent gaze, pale luminous complexion, and long light hair; dressed in elegant white and silver fairytale garments with subtle northern embroidery, poised and resolute, carrying an air of quiet authority from Whiteland.

name: The White-Bearded Guide
description: An old man on Whiteland’s shore who knows the trolls’ curse and gives the precise counsel that makes rescue possible.
visualPrompt: Elderly man with a long white beard and weathered face, wrapped in a simple grey cloak; he stands on a white, stony shoreline with a staff in hand, eyes sharp and knowing, like a guardian of old secrets.

name: The North Wind
description: A roaring, personified force of nature who helps the young king drive away the false suitor and reclaim the castle.
visualPrompt: Mythic embodiment of the North Wind as a towering, swirling presence of icy blue and white gusts, suggesting a stern face in the storm; the air around it crackles with cold power, bending trees and tugging at castle walls.

name: The Jealous King
description: The ruler who raised the fisherman’s son, but whose envy provokes the moment that causes the queen to vanish back to Whiteland.
visualPrompt: Middle-aged king with a proud, tight expression, wearing heavy gold-trimmed robes and a crown; his posture is rigid and possessive, eyes narrowed with jealousy in a grand hall lit by warm torchlight.
